hits.s: Formation: Lysing A pre-torqued, 18 1/2” HT60 core barrel, was picked up, made up and run in hole. The assembly was dressed with pressure vented aluminium JamBuster inner tubes, and pre-torqued 12 1/4 1/4, BHC 409Z PDC core head. Tight hole from 2605m to 2650m MD, pumped with 1350 lpm. Also tight hole at 3198m, 3208m ,3223m ,3225m and 4062m MD. RIH to two stands off bottom, washed down w/1800 lpm. Tagged bottom, circ

bottom and tried to re-start. Reduced to 60 rpm and low weight, had some torque problems when tagged bottom, kept same parameters and torque decreased. Started to core. Had steady parameter through the hole run, and cored 18m. No overpull. Circulated bottoms up and started to pull OHH. Tight hole all the way up to the shoe. Had to backream with 375 lpm and 10 rpm.
